description: What it does FLUX 3 Video Generator is a browser-based workspace for creating short videos with synchronized audio. Start from a text prompt or guide the result with images, video references, first and last frames, dialogue, and sound direction. Key benefits - Generate video and audio together in one workflow - Use text, images, references, or keyframes for more control - Describe dialogue, ambience, and sound effects alongside the visuals - Iterate without installing local software It is built
